name: skill-forge-1.0.0
description: Autonomous skill builder — research APIs, generate OpenClaw skills, and self-deploy them into the workspace

tools.name: skill_forge_create
tools.description: Generate a complete OpenClaw skill from an API specification. Creates SKILL.md, index.js, and package.json in the workspace skills directory. The skill is ready to use after a gateway reload.

description.description: One-line description of what the skill does

auth_env_var.description: Environment variable name for the API key/token (e.g. 'NOTION_API_KEY')

auth_header.description: Custom header name for api-key-header auth (default: 'Authorization')

tools.description: Array of tool definitions to generate

path.description: API endpoint path (e.g. '/pages', '/issues/{id}'). Use {param} for path params.

npm_dependencies.description: Additional npm dependencies (e.g. { "ws": "^8.0.0" }). Most skills need none — built-in https is preferred.

tools.name: skill_forge_validate
tools.description: Validate an existing skill directory has correct structure (SKILL.md, package.json with tools array, index.js with matching exports). Returns detailed report of issues found.

skill_name.description: Name of the skill directory to validate (e.g. 'weather-1.0.0')

tools.name: skill_forge_list
tools.description: List all skills in the workspace with their version, tool count, and whether they have valid structure. Identifies forge-created skills vs manually installed ones.

tools.name: skill_forge_from_openapi
tools.description: Generate a complete OpenClaw skill from an OpenAPI/Swagger JSON spec. Provide the spec as a URL or raw JSON string. Automatically extracts endpoints, parameters, auth, and generates all tool definitions.

spec_url.description: URL to fetch the OpenAPI JSON spec from

spec_json.description: Raw OpenAPI JSON spec string (use this OR spec_url, not both)

auth_env_var.description: Environment variable name for the API key/token

include_paths.description: Only include these path prefixes (e.g. ['/v1/issues', '/v1/projects']). If empty, includes all.

exclude_methods.description: HTTP methods to exclude (e.g. ['DELETE'] for read-only skills)

max_tools.description: Maximum number of tools to generate (default: 20, to avoid bloat)
